description.value: PAUL Bakery, Café & Restaurant is the Vancouver outpost of the French artisan bakery chain founded in 1889, positioned here as a full-service dining destination on busy Robson Street. The space offers indoor and outdoor seating and hosts regular evening events including live music and a Martini Society. A touring cyclist looking for a sit-down meal, pastries, or bread in the West End will find a polished, accessible café experience.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 22m; rack (5 spaces) at 27m; stands (4 spaces) at 33m; rack (5 spaces) at 35m; stands (2 spaces) at 45m; stands (2 spaces) at 77m; stands (2 spaces) at 79m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 98m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as the PAUL franchise bakery/café/restaurant at 1164 Robson Street, Vancouver, matched via shop=bakery. The website (paul-bc.com) is live and corroborates the brand identity as a sit-down café and restaurant with menus, reservations, high tea, and live music events, confirming the business is open and active. Neither the OSM tags nor the website content mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so most checklist fields are null.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM record.
Category 'Groceries' is a poor fit; this is a full-service café/restaurant, not a grocery store — consider recategorizing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café and restaurant on a major Vancouver street; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and seating.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery was matched to Groceries, but PAUL operates primarily as a sit-down café and restaurant with reservations and a full menu; a Café or Restaurant category would be more accurate, though the bakery component does sell food products.
